dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #He doesn't have that flaming pattern on his horn... this isn't {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, where'd this little guy come from?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! It's the saurian egg from back then!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that was a Tepetlisaurus egg...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon remembers the person protecting the egg gave it a name... So this little one would be "Aguara," right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, it looks like you know your own name!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Just like {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, this little guy doesn't have a home anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Why not come with us? Hehe, Paimon and {NICKNAME} are the bestest at making friends with Tepetlisaurs!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe... Paimon knew you'd say yes!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You put a red cloth on Aguara, just as you once did with your former companion.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The last wearer of that scarf grew up to become a very, very special guy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aguara! Paimon hopes you'll be just like him, and grow up h—happy and h—healthy...!
